NNEW CONCEPT ENGLISHBOOK 01 / 新概念英语

BOOK ONE · LESSON 072

When did you ...?

你什么时候……？

A bilingual lesson built around 15 past-tense verb illustrations (aired, cleaned, opened, sharpened, turned on, listened, boiled, arrived, played, stayed, shaved, climbed, telephoned, called, emptied) in three rows and a time-phrase reference table (TODAY / YESTERDAY / THE DAY BEFORE YESTERDAY), practising 'When did you ...?' with regular verbs in the simple past. Includes textbook written exercises on completing sentences and writing questions and answers, workbook dialogues with regular past verbs and situations, and grammar on answering 'When did ...?' questions and completing dialogues. 以15幅过去时动词插图（ aired、cleaned、opened、sharpened、turned on、listened、boiled、arrived、played、stayed、shaved、climbed、telephoned、called、emptied）和三行时间短语对照表（今天/昨天/前天）为主的双语课，练习规则动词一般过去时的「你什么时候……？」句型。配合教材书面练习（完成句子、提问并回答）、教材填空对话与情景练习，以及「何时……？」问句回答和完成对话的语法练习。

When did you ...? 你什么时候……？

Listen and answer the questions. When did you ...?

TODAY: this morning, this afternoon, this evening, tonight
YESTERDAY: yesterday morning, yesterday afternoon, yesterday evening, last night
THE DAY BEFORE YESTERDAY: the day before yesterday in the morning, the day before yesterday in the afternoon, the day before yesterday in the evening, the night before last

今天：今天上午、今天下午、今天晚上、今晚
昨天：昨天上午、昨天下午、昨天晚上、昨夜
前天：前天上午、前天下午、前天晚上、前天夜里

1st: aired 2nd: cleaned 3rd: opened 4th: sharpened 5th: turned on

第1幅：通风 第2幅：打扫 第3幅：打开 第4幅：削尖 第5幅：打开（电器）

第6幅：听 第7幅：煮 第8幅：到达 第9幅：玩耍 第10幅：待着

11th: shaved 12th: climbed 13th: telephoned 14th: called 15th: emptied

Notes on the text 课文注释

一般过去时的时间短语

本课的时间短语分为三组：今天（TODAY）：this morning, this afternoon, this evening, tonight；昨天（YESTERDAY）：yesterday morning, yesterday afternoon, yesterday evening, last night；前天（THE DAY BEFORE YESTERDAY）：the day before yesterday in the morning/afternoon/evening, the night before last。

规则动词的一般过去时

规则动词的过去式一般是在动词原形后加 ed，如 clean/cleaned, arrive/arrived, listen/listened, play/played, stay/stayed。以不发音的 e 结尾的动词只加 d，如 open/opened, turn/turned。以辅音字母加 y 结尾的动词变 y 为 i 再加 ed，如 carry/carried。
